```yaml
architecture:
  style: nestjs
  layers:
    - name: domain
      kind: domain
      directories:
        - src/app/models/**
        - src/app/**/models/**
        - src/app/validators/**
      file_patterns:
        - "**/*.model.ts"
        - "**/*.graphql.ts"
      roles:
        - entity
        - value-object
        - domain-service
        - repository-interface

    - name: infrastructure
      kind: infrastructure
      directories:
        - src/app/database/**
        - src/app/redis/**
        - src/app/config/**
        - src/app/cookie/**
        - src/app/options/**
      file_patterns:
        - "**/*.repository.ts"
        - "**/*.provider.ts"
      roles:
        - repository-impl
        - orm-entity
        - external-service
        - middleware
        - worker

    - name: application
      kind: application
      directories: []
      file_patterns:
        - "**/*.service.ts"
        - "**/*.processor.ts"
        - "**/*.dto.ts"
      roles:
        - use-case
        - dto
        - application-service
        - processor

    - name: presentation
      kind: presentation
      directories:
        - src/app/guards/**
      file_patterns:
        - "**/*.controller.ts"
        - "**/*.module.ts"
        - "**/*.guard.ts"
        - "**/*.interceptor.ts"
        - "**/*.gateway.ts"
      roles:
        - controller
        - module
        - gateway
        - guard
        - interceptor
      decorators:
        - "@Controller"
        - "@Module"

```
